Maintenance._comment: Set Enabled to true to take the system offline: every API call answers 503 and the web app shows the message. AllowedIps keep working (e.g. the admin doing the upgrade). No rebuild needed.
Maintenance.Message: The system is under maintenance. Please try again shortly.

RateLimit._comment: Per-IP cap on Auth/login. Account lockout thresholds live in proj.TBL_APP_SETTINGS (Login.*).

Smtp._comment: SMTP settings are stored in proj.TBL_APP_SETTINGS — not here.
